articles.title: Isro launches EOS-05 satellite: India's first dedicated geostationary Earth-observation satellite
articles.description: In a notable achievement, Isro has successfully launched the EOS-05 satellite aboard the GSLV-F17 vehicle. The satellite will offer near real-time imagery that supports various applications. Prime Minister Modi commended the success, calling it a remarkable moment for India's space endeavors. Isro's chairman also mentioned enhancements in GSLV capabilities for handling larger payloads. Plans for future launches, including the Gaganyaan mission, are underway this year.

articles.title: Texas Republicans turn against data centers, putting Big Tech on notice
articles.description: In a surprising turn, Republican leaders are now standing against data center projects due to increasing public resistance. This development coincides with a surge of support for Democrats from local communities opposing such facilities. Texas Governor Greg Abbott has advocated for tighter restrictions on data centers. Big tech firms are investing heavily to combat unfavorable public opinion, highlighting the emerging political divide among Republicans.
